issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies numberOfTutors as type int, and students will expect to implement/access this attribute and related methods using int. However, the solution implementation declares the field numberOfTutors as short and uses a constructor parameter and setter with short. This creates a type mismatch between the specification (and the expected getters/setters) and the solution reference, which may confuse students about the intended type and lead to inconsistencies when they follow the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfTutors consistent with the UML/problem statement by changing the solution's field and related constructor/setter parameter types to int (i.e., declare numberOfTutors as int and update the constructor and setNumberOfTutors signature to accept int). This aligns the solution with the specification and avoids confusing students.
